long_notes:
Hi guys! This update brings major improvements to Pattern Detection bot’s logic. It can now search 2-move patterns in addition to 3 and 4-move patterns, and it is capable of doing much deeper searches without skipping potential patterns. These changes have let Pattern Detection win nearly 12% more games than previously, according to internal testing.

Oh, and speaking of internal testing, I had the five shortcut bots play a total of 5,000 games against each other, across five different seeds, and I saved the results in a nice PDF with charts! You can check it out at this link:

https://github.com/TheCodeWan/My-Shortcuts/blob/main/RPS%20AI%20Bot%20Tournament%20Report.pdf

I’ve also made updates to the GitHub updater to allow for things such as beta versions and better migration, plus the usual bug fixes and improvements. Enjoy!
